cues: Auxin, from the shoot apex: elongation and apical dominance.
Cytokinin, from the root apex: cell division, and it delays ageing.
Abscisic acid: closes stomata and keeps seeds dormant.
And ethylene: ripens fruit and makes leaves fall.
text: All five on one card. Auxin, from the shoot apex: elongation and apical dominance. Gibberellin: internode elongation and bolting. Cytokinin, from the root apex: cell division, and it delays ageing. Abscisic acid: closes stomata and keeps seeds dormant. And ethylene: ripens fruit and makes leaves fall.
